question: How should the site be divided before determining the structural measures?
premises: Divisions beginning with four parts are to be made.
One of these parts is to be taken as a unit.
inference: One should divide the area into four or more parts and take one part as the unit.
uncertainties: The upper limit implied by ādi and bhānu-anta is not explicit.
plain_english: Having divided it into four parts or other such divisions, one should take one part as the unit.
